text:
Alex P: Heads-up: meeting with two SI partners next week. Need a crisp SI -> AE handoff process that avoids duplicates and speeds triage. Draft rules below.

Maya S: Love this. Can we keep marketplace vs SI flows separate? Marketplace leads are lower touch, SI deals need a pre-call.

Ben K: Agreed. Quick draft: 1) partner_submit -> validate (partner_id + email) 2) dedupe check in CRM 3) route. If dedupe hits, auto-notify partner + owning AE.

Priya N: Also add conflict resolution: if two partners claim same opportunity, partner-of-record = first validated submission timestamp. If disputed, Partnerships mediates within 48h.

Liam T: For SI co-sell, require a partner engagement plan doc (one pager) attached to the lead. If missing, route to Partnerships queue for intake.

Alex P: Concrete rule set (v0):

- rule A: submission_validation: partner_id & contact_email required. Missing -> reject form with reason.
- rule B: dedupe_logic: CRM match by domain OR account_name -> if match found, append partner_lead tag and ping owning_AE + partner.
- rule C: routing_matrix: marketplace -> Partner_SDR; SI -> AE_assigned + SE + Partnerships.
- rule D: dispute_path: first_validated_submission wins; Partnerships has 48h to escalate to Sales leadership.

Ben K: SLA proposal: ack (automated) immediate; human ack by AE/SDR within 12 business hours; technical review booked within 3 business days. Emergency escalation (C-level ask) -> 2 business days.

Maya S: 12 business hours is tight for EMEA. Make it 24 business hours regionally with auto-notice in local timezone.

Priya N: Measurement: track these KPIs for the pilot: mean_time_to_ack, percent_with_engagement_plan, duplicate_rate, time_to_first_TECH_CALL. We'll need a dashboard in Looker/Metabase.

Liam T: Operational bits: CRM fields to add: partner_of_record, partner_submission_ts, partner_lead_id, engagement_plan_url. Also add tag values: partner:si, partner:marketplace, partner:disputed.

Alex P: Example flow for AccelSys (SI): partner creates lead -> validation passes -> dedupe finds no match -> route AE=EMEA-default (from mapping sheet) + SE assigned -> Partnerships schedules intro -> partner provides engagement_plan -> AE+SE do scoping call within 3 days.

Ben K: I'm building the mapping sheet: columns = partner, region, default_AE, backup_AE, PO_contact, typical_deal_size. Will share link.

Maya S: Legal wants a short partner-intro email template we can reuse. I'll draft and share. Also need a checkbox for NDA_required in lead form.

Priya N: Pilot scope suggestion: run for 6 weeks with two SIs and the cloud marketplace. Measure KPIs weekly and converge rules at week 4.

Alex P: Action list:
- Ben:Create mapping sheet + webhook to #partnerships (due Tue)
- Maya: Draft partner intro email + NDA checkbox for form (due Wed)
- Priya: Build KPI dashboard spec (due Fri)
- Liam: Draft minimal engagement_plan template and intake checklist (due Wed)
- Alex: Coordinate with Sales Ops for CRM fields and dedupe rules (open ticket)

Maya S: Small ask: can we add a tag to indicate HW partner vs SI vs cloud? Hardware partners tend to need on-site POC and longer lead cycles.

Ben K: Done. Sheet will include partner_type and typical_cycle_weeks.

Alex P: OK everyone, I'll run this with the SI leads next week and we'll refine post-pilot. Tagging this thread as the process source. If anyone wants ownership on the dispute workflow, speak now.

Priya N: I'll own dispute mediation during the pilot.

Liam T: I'll join the AccelSys call and walk through engagement template.

Ben K: Sheet posted -> <link hidden>. Will post again with webhook details. :rocket:

Maya S: Thanks all. Short, actionable feels good.

Alex P: Thanks team. Will follow up with updated doc + intake form link.
